{{Use dmy dates|date=August 2020}} {{Use Hiberno-English|date=August 2020}} {{Infobox football match | title = 1994 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final | image = | event = [[1994 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|1994 Munster Senior Hurling Championship]] | team1 = {{GG|Limerick|hurling}} | team1association = [[File:Limerick colours.PNG|40px]] | team1score = 0-25 | team2 = {{GG|Clare|hurling}} | team2association = [[File:Portumna GAA colours.PNG|40px]] | team2score = 2-10 | details = | date = 10 July 1994 | stadium = [[Semple Stadium]] | city = [[Thurles]] | man_of_the_match1a = | referee = [[Willie Barrett]] (Tipperary) | attendance = 43,638 | weather = Dry | previous = [[1993 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final|1993]] | next = [[1995 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final|1995]] }} The '''1994 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final''' was a [[hurling]] match played on 10 July 1994 at [[Semple Stadium]], [[Thurles]], [[County Tipperary]]. It was contested by [[Limerick county hurling team|Limerick]] and [[Clare county hurling team|Clare]]. Limerick, captained by [[Gary Kirby]], won the game 0-25 to 2-10 to claim their first Munster title since 1981.{{cite web|url=https://www.irishtimes.com/sport/limerick-0-25-clare-2-10-1.58862 |title =LIMERICK 0-25, CLARE 2-10|date=|work=Irish Times|accessdate=12 June 2019}}{{cite web|url=https://extra.ie/2017/06/03/sport/gaa/limerick-clare|title=Limerick v Clare: One of hurling's most storied rivalries|date=3 June 2017|work=Extra Time|first=Patrick|last=Lynch|accessdate=9 August 2020|archive-date=31 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200831093022/https://extra.ie/2017/06/03/sport/gaa/limerick-clare|url-status=live}}{{cite web|url=http://munster.gaa.ie/history/sh_teams/|title=Munster Final Winning Teams|work=Munster.gaa.ie|accessdate=23 June 2011|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110721124423/http://munster.gaa.ie/history/sh_teams/|archivedate=21 July 2011|url-status=dead}} ==Match== ===Details=== {{football box |date=10 July
